svg.title: vol-strategy-backtester data model: per-run ledger

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Built in M3: 12 tables, written once per run. run_id is the run's folder name (runs/run_id=<id>/), not a column. Planned: signals (M4), greeks_snapshots (M5).
